subject: ShellPkg/Ls: Hard-code number of files if none found
reasons: Single-line change: PrintNonSfoFooter(FileCount, FileSize, DirCount) replaced with PrintNonSfoFooter(0, 0, 0) in one location
One-off fix at a single call site - no repetitive pattern across files or within the file
While structurally simple, the change encodes domain-specific semantic knowledge (when !Found, counts must be zero) rather than a mechanical transformation
